evidence.title: GitHub - fleetbase/fleetbase: Modular logistics and supply chain operating system (LSOS) · GitHub

name: Fleetbase
summary: Open-source modular logistics and supply chain operating system for dispatch, tracking, commerce and warehousing.
description: A self-hosted (Docker) or cloud platform for logistics operations, assembled from modules installed into a console: Fleet-Ops dispatch with live tracking and route optimization, Storefront commerce, Pallet warehousing, Ledger invoicing, a customer portal, IAM, an AI module and developer tooling. Ships a REST API, WebSockets, webhooks, an extension marketplace and open-source iOS/Android driver and storefront apps.
contains: modules: Fleet-Ops, Storefront, Pallet, Ledger, Customer Portal, AI, IAM, Developers, Navigator App, Storefront App
open-source iOS and Android driver and storefront apps
REST API, WebSockets, webhooks and an extension marketplace
screenshots: order kanban board, live operations map, geofences, ledger
Docker self-host, Fleetbase Cloud or own-cloud deployment; free trial
dual license: AGPL-3.0-or-later or a commercial license
